title: fix: keep the code and message of every terminal stream error
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces the per-producer branches in `finishReasonError` (`gen.pollinations.ai/src/middleware/track.ts`) with one extractor that finds the terminal error object in the three protocol positions: Chat `{error}`, Responses `{type:"error"}`, `{type:"response.failed", response:{error}}`
- Every stream error now reaches Tinybird with its own `error_response_code` and `error_message`; before, only `upstream_stream_error` kept its message and `agent_error` collapsed to "Upstream ended generation with finish_reason=error" (124 real-user agent 502s in 7 days, see #14994)
- Drops the `usage_missing` special-cased fallback string; the validator's own message is recorded instead
- Net −18 lines in track.ts; adds a regression test for `agent_error`; updates the Chat-over-Responses failure test to the passed-through `upstream_error` code and message
- Verified: gen tsc, tracking-observability (72), generation-vcr + responses + text-cache (98), biome 2.3.10

Addresses #14994

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Errors keep their names
gist.blurb: The stream-error courier stopped losing its labels somewhere in the hive. Terminal failures now arrive in Tinybird with the code and message they were born with.
gist.summary: Unified terminal stream-error extraction in gen.pollinations.ai so Chat `{error}`, Responses `{type:"error"}`, and `response.failed` events each record their original error code and message in Tinybird.
gist.impact: Developers and operators can now distinguish real stream failures—including previously collapsed agent 502s—using the upstream error details instead of a generic finish-reason message.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful mail carrier in a cozy observability garden, sorting three differently shaped terminal-error envelopes into labeled jars on a glowing analytics terminal. Each envelope retains its own code and message, while code-plants and small flowers make the tracking system feel organized and alive.
